entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.

entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges. It supports scoped data access for multi-user company environments and provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library provides a FastAPI server for building stateful agents through managed or self-hosted use. It offers hybrid search, prompt-ready context injection, and client SDKs for Python and TypeScript.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This sub-millisecond memory system for Hermes Agents utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system incorporates vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This context harness supports multiple providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, and local models. It generates filesystem-based traces, reports, and playbooks to assist agents with complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite-backed message store. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG to ensure messages are never lost.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub and reports a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes a local-first architecture to store memory as human-readable YAML engrams on a local disk. It provides shared context across multiple MCP tools and AI agents without requiring cloud API calls.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search and integrates through MCP, Claude Code hooks, and plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference by using block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to reduce prefill latency and token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This durable, file-based memory system uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by including a why_retrieved tag with every recall. It features contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and a self-directing loop for knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using local-first SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.

entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports real, immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage memory.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox alongside tools for searching and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables APIs to charge for themselves using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes and other agent frameworks.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing by directing questions to whole artifacts instead of using chunk RAG. It registers five native tools for knowledge search, retrieval, and feedback.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
